commits.message:
Update README

use the output of snapshot tests

Harden flow layout against non-finite arithmetic

Replace the NaN->infinity placement band-aid and ad-hoc NaN masking with
root-cause handling so degenerate (infinite/NaN) dimensions cannot reach
CoreGraphics:

- skip non-finite depth/breadth alignment offsets instead of propagating them
- fall back to the natural size when justifying under an unbounded proposal
- exclude zero-size line-break markers from justified space distribution
- clamp the final placement point so NaN/+-inf never reach place(at:)

Add LayoutEngineTests for infinite item depth/breadth and unbounded justified width.

Update snapshots

Fix silent item-drop when an item overflows the container

Both line-breakers silently discarded items whose minimum size exceeds
the available space:

- FlowLineBreaker: the else-if guard meant that when currentLine was
  empty and the new item overflowed, neither branch executed and the
  item was lost; every subsequent item was then also lost because
  currentLine stayed stuck at [overflowItem].

- KnuthPlassLineBreaker: overflow items kept costs[end]=∞, leaving
  breaks[count]=nil so the reconstruction returned [].

Fix:
- FlowLineBreaker always starts a new line on any miss; the final
  flush uses fallbackLine() when sizes() returns nil.
- KnuthPlassLineBreaker allows a single-item overflow segment in the DP
  with a penalty equal to overflow², so it is chosen only as a last
  resort but always produces a finite cost.
- Add shared fallbackLine() helper that places items at minimum size.

Add unit tests for both breakers and integration tests covering a
single oversized item and an oversized item surrounded by normal items.

Fix cross-axis baseline alignment in flow layout (#43)

HFlow(alignment: .firstTextBaseline) did not align item baselines like
HStack does. The depth alignment used a proportional formula
(guide/itemDepth)*(lineDepth-itemDepth), which is only correct when the
guide is a fixed fraction of the item's height (top/center/bottom). A text
baseline sits at an absolute offset, so items were mis-positioned and the
line height (max item depth) reserved no room below the common baseline.

Switch to the guide-based model HStack uses: per line, ascent = max guide,
descent = max(itemDepth - guide), line depth = ascent + descent, and each
item is placed at depth += ascent - itemGuide. This reduces exactly to the
previous behavior for top/center/bottom guides. The per-item guide is now
computed once during layout and stored, removing a duplicate dimensions
query in alignAndPlace. Non-finite arithmetic guards are preserved.

Fixes #37

Fix VFlow/HFlow clipping inside .frame(maxHeight:) in a ScrollView (#44)

When .frame(maxHeight:) sits inside a vertical ScrollView, the frame passes
the parent's nil (unbounded) height proposal straight through to the layout's
placeSubviews, while allocating a finite bounds.height equal to maxHeight after
clamping the reported natural size. The layout then used ∞ for column/row
breaking and placed all items in a single oversized column, which the frame
clipped at maxHeight.

Fix: in placeSubviews, when the proposal's axis dimension is unbounded, fall
back to bounds.size (axis dimension) so columns/rows break at the real clip
boundary. Reduces to the original code path for any finite proposal.

Fixes #19

Fix cross-axis expansion: items with maxWidth/maxHeight .infinity fill their column/row natural width (#45)

Views using .frame(maxWidth: .infinity) inside VFlow were proposed infinite
width, causing them to expand beyond the column bounds. The fix detects items
whose max depth is infinite (and ideal is finite) and proposes the column's
natural depth — the maximum ideal depth of all items in that column — instead
of infinity. Items with a finite maxWidth/maxHeight are unaffected.

Fixes #36

LazyHFlow/LazyVFlow (#46)

* Fix greeter

* LazyHFlow/LazyVFlow

Introduces LazyHFlow (backed by LazyVGrid) and LazyVFlow (backed by
LazyHGrid) as opt-in alternatives for large datasets where the eager
per-item measurement of the Layout-protocol-based HFlow/VFlow is too
expensive. Items are arranged in a uniform adaptive grid rather than an
exact flow, which is clearly documented. Cross-reference notes added to
HFlow and VFlow doc comments.

Resolves #9

Fix line-breaking cache miss for infinite proposals (ScrollView/unconstrained)

sizeThatFits stores a cache key with breadth=∞ when the layout receives an
unbounded proposal (e.g. inside a ScrollView). placeSubviews then calls
effectiveProposal, which substitutes bounds.width for the infinite breadth, and
looks up a different key — so the single-entry memo introduced for back-to-back
layout passes never fired for the most common unconstrained case.

After sizeThatFits computes the natural width it is about to report, re-key the
cached entry to {naturalWidth, depth}. SwiftUI passes that exact width back as
bounds.width, so the effectiveProposal key matches and placeSubviews gets a
cache hit, skipping the redundant line-breaking pass.

Fix Knuth-Plass line breaker dropping all items under unbounded space

When the available breadth is infinite (e.g. a .distributed flow inside a
ScrollView, or when SwiftUI proposes .unspecified to query the ideal size), the
squared-leftover space penalty is infinite for every candidate break. Because the
cost array is seeded with .infinity and the solver only records a break on a
strictly-smaller cost, no break point is ever stored — rebuildLines then walks
back from a nil terminal break and returns an empty layout, so the flow renders
nothing and reports a zero ideal size.

There is nothing to optimize when space is unbounded: wrapping never lowers the
cost. Delegate to the greedy FlowLineBreaker, which keeps everything on one line
while still honoring manual line breaks.

Proper LazyHFlow and LazyVFlow

Lazy horizontal/vertical flow views that reveal items incrementally
inside a ScrollView while matching the layout of HFlow/VFlow. Support
cross-axis alignment, item/line spacing, justified rows, and even
distribution.

The reveal is driven by onChange(of: numberOfVisible) so it keeps
loading until the viewport is filled, rather than relying on the
content's bounding box changing — which previously stalled the reveal
once a row/column stopped growing along the scroll axis.
Fix Knuth-Plass solver splitting lines under negative spacing

Add item and line separators to HFlow and VFlow

Introduce `.itemSeparator { }` and `.lineSeparator { }` on HFlow/VFlow that draw separators between items and/or lines, never at the edges.
Fixes for line separator and line cap
Fix image snapshots at regular display scale
README snapshot tests for maxLines and separators
